content.name: Potion of Water Breathing
entries: You can breathe underwater for 1 hour after drinking this potion. Its cloudy green fluid smells of the sea and has a jellyfish-like bubble floating in it.

content.name: Potion of Water Breathing
entries: You can breathe underwater for 24 hours after drinking this potion.
This potion's cloudy green fluid smells of the sea and has a jellyfish-like bubble floating in it.
